title: Completed Tower Defense music variants

tracks.title: Quiet Battlements
tracks.prompt: Instrumental medieval acoustic fantasy music at a gentle 72 BPM, with warm wooden flute, restrained lute and soft sustained strings in D minor. Calm, dignified and focused, with spacious repeating phrases, a sparse rising four-note flute motif and a natural acoustic recording sound, without vocals or a playful tavern rhythm. Maintain an even gentle texture across 96 seconds, with a short opening and an ending that returns to the opening harmony for a possible edited loop.

tracks.title: March of the Siege
tracks.prompt: Instrumental dark orchestral medieval battle music at 88 BPM in D minor, dominated by massive low war drums and timpani in a disciplined heavy marching rhythm. Sparse low horns, tense cellos and a restrained rising four-note motif reinforce a stern, weighty and threatening pulse, with clear space for speech and no vocals or cheerful melodies. Enter immediately with the drums and sustain controlled intensity across 96 seconds, ending in the opening harmonic state rather than a large final cadence.

tracks.title: The Bastion Stands
tracks.prompt: An eight-second instrumental orchestral royal victory fanfare with noble horns and trumpets announcing a concise rising four-note motif over two powerful timpani accents. Dignified triumph in D major, with a clear resolved final chord and a short natural acoustic decay, beginning immediately and containing no vocals.

tracks.title: Whispers of the Grove
tracks.prompt: Instrumental acoustic fantasy music at a gentle 68 BPM in D Dorian, featuring breath-soft wooden pipes, pan flute, delicate harp notes and quiet low string drones. Peaceful, mysterious and spacious, with a sparse rising four-note pipe motif, generous silence between phrases and no vocals or playful dance beat. Keep a stable gentle texture across 96 seconds and return naturally to the opening harmony for a possible edited loop.

tracks.title: Drums Beneath the Roots
tracks.prompt: Instrumental dark organic fantasy battle music at 84 BPM in D minor, dominated by deep resonant hide drums and frame drums in a deliberate interlocking ritual rhythm. Low strings, distant hollow horns and a sparse rising four-note horn motif create grave ancient menace and forceful weight, with no voices, chants or bright folk melody. Start with the drum pulse immediately, sustain controlled intensity across 96 seconds and return to the opening harmonic state without a large final cadence.

tracks.title: The Grove Endures
tracks.prompt: An eight-second instrumental acoustic fantasy victory fanfare with noble French horns playing a concise ascending four-note call, answered by one clear wooden-flute phrase above a warm harp chord. Proud, restrained triumph in D major, starting immediately and finishing on a confident resolved chord with a brief natural decay and no vocals.

tracks.title: Embers in the Courtyard
tracks.prompt: Instrumental quiet medieval fantasy music at a slow 64 BPM in D minor, featuring a solitary low wooden flute, sparse lute and muted sustained strings. Peaceful and sheltered yet solemn, with restrained sadness and determination, a sparse rising four-note flute motif, generous space and no vocals or lively dance rhythm. Maintain calm repeating phrases across 96 seconds, with a short opening and a natural return to the opening harmony for a possible edited loop.

tracks.title: Under the Black Banner
tracks.prompt: Instrumental dark orchestral medieval battle music at a deliberate 76 BPM in D minor, dominated by enormous resonant bass war drums, heavy timpani and crushing widely spaced accents. Ominous low brass, tense cellos, sparse metallic percussion and a restrained rising four-note motif create extremely serious threatening weight, with room for speech and no vocals or cheerful melody. Enter immediately with the drums, sustain heavy controlled tension throughout 96 seconds and return to the opening harmonic state without a victory cadence.

tracks.title: The Crown Unbroken
tracks.prompt: An eight-second instrumental orchestral victory fanfare with powerful low brass rising into a solemn trumpet declaration over heavy timpani. A concise ascending four-note motif shifts from D minor tension to a proud D major resolution, grand and dignified, with an immediate entrance, a clear final chord and short natural decay, without vocals.
